To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the superbranes propagates in AdS supergravity backgrounds are described by the following action S = S D + S F + S G + S B, where S D is the Dirac-Born-Infeld action for a superbrane in AdS × S superbackgrounds, S F is a fermionic action that is the most general action that is invariant under the super-Poincare group, S G is the Wess-Zumino term for the supergroup G = OSp
the superbackgrounds of AdS × S are coset space manifolds, that they can be used to describe superbranes with worldvolume supersymmetry, and that their actions have a simple fermionic structure.

the superbrane actions in the AdS superbackground can be constructed by the following steps: (i) the superbackgrounds are realized as coset spaces, (ii) the κ -symmetry is consistently gauge-fixed and (iii) the superconnections are constructed in the gauge-fixed background.
In summary, our research is concerned with
superbranes in supercoset backgrounds and their gauge fixed actions.
superbrane actions on the supergroup manifold of the coset space G/H, with H a supergroup.
a systematic construction of superbrane actions describing superbranes in AdS supergravity backgrounds.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are able to present the first superbrane actions with a polynomial fermionic dependence of the order of four in Grassmann coordinates.

, at present, we are able to construct a gauge-invariant superbrane action for the case of a superbrane propagating in a superbackground with a single AdS factor, and a gauge-invariant and gauge-fixed superbrane action for a superbrane propaginating in a superbackground which is a product of AdS and S.

the superbrane actions for supermembrane, D2-brane and M2-brane in AdS×S backgrounds are described by a finite number of Grassmann variables, namely, the supermembrane by four and the D2-brane by two.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have constructed a class of superbrane actions with a manifest AdS× S supersymmetry, which is the maximal possible supersymmetry for superbranes in AdS×S backgrounds.
the superbrane actions in the AdS× S background are constructed in terms of the supercoset space approach.
the coset space construction allows to obtain superbrane actions which have a manifest AdS× S isometry group.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the superbrane actions in the AdS× S backgrounds are not only consistent with the static brane solution but they also admit a gauge-fixed action in terms of worldvolume fields.
, despite the fact that the superbrane actions we obtain are not manifestly κ -symmetric, the corresponding equations of motion do preserve the κ -symmetry, as it should be.
, contrary to the common lore, the superbrane action can be formulated as an integral over the worldvolume of a superdeterminant of the worldvolume supervielbeins.
